notes: One place for PStack model defaults. primary is the workspace opencode.jsonc model. worker is pstack-agent, reviewer is pstack-reviewer, comment-sicko is pstack-comment-sicko. Install-Workspace.ps1 injects these into the installed agent profiles. Change a value here, then rerun Install-Workspace.ps1 -Apply. The OpenChamber per-project default model is separate app state and is not applied by this file.
